title: Works but is really cheaply made
text:
Works but is really cheaply made. Very cheap plastic, doesn't feel durable at all. Feels like it would break extremely easily and I doubt it'll hold up to much use.

That being said- it does what it's supposed to do and slices and cuts everything up decently. I think this an OK product but I am not super excited about it.
